stem: What would be the most likely effect of a wildfire that burned a large area of a forest?

options.label: F
options.text: More sugars and starches would be available for animals in the area.

options.label: G
options.text: The availability of fossil fuels for use by industries in the area would be reduced.

options.label: H
options.text: Less carbon dioxide would be removed from the atmosphere in the area by plants.

options.label: J
options.text: An increase in animal respiration would increase the release of carbon dioxide in the area.
